text:
sarah_lee: Heads-up — Hosted API streaming + tool-calling is GA as of today (rolling from 12:00 PT). New endpoints, improved latency for long-lived streams, and explicit tool-calling format for secure tool integrations.

ben_f: Awesome!!! Congrats team. Any user-impacting changes?

sarah_lee: No breaking changes for existing sync endpoints. New endpoints:
- /v2/stream (SSE chunked json)
- /v2/tool_call_stream (structured function outputs + tool metadata)

sarah_lee: Quick curl example:
```
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" https://api.redwood.com/v2/tool_call_stream -d '{"model":"rwd-anthem-2","input":"Find me recent sales tickets for ACME"}'
```

mike_security: Routing to @security — how are call payloads logged? retention and PII concerns.

sarah_lee: Good q. Default: tool-call payloads are NOT persisted to search logs; we store call metadata (latency, model, result hash) for observability. Customers can opt-in to store full payloads via org settings with KMS encryption.

emily_product: Note on quotas: paid plans increase concurrent streaming sessions to 10; free tier stays at 2. We also added a "streaming-cost" meter that shows token burn in near-real time in Console.

deploy-bot: deploy noticed: rollout stage=prod streaming-service v1.3.2 started at 2026-03-12T19:43:00Z (CI #7721)

cto_jen: Love it. Please add runbook link and the opt-in checkbox UI mock to the product ticket.

sarah_lee: Added runbook + UI mock here: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/streaming-toolcall-ga (internal). Ping @sales for the customer talking points.

ben_f: Will prep customer email + APAC timing notes. :rocket:

mike_security: +1, logging design LGTM, will follow up on compliance doc.

sarah_lee: Thx all — small FYI: if you see any perf regressions, tag #eng-runtime and I'll follow up. :tada:
